question: What do you do when two things need your attention at the same time?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “I can get pulled onto one thing and lose track of the other—that’s what happened with the bus card and the bibs. Sometimes my housemate reads the jobs back while I gather things, which helps me keep track. I still do the gathering! And now the card’s in the bag pocket, so at least those two are together.”
